scenes.narration: So here is what a hash table buys you.
scenes.headline: A key becomes an address in one step
items: Look up, insert and delete take **O(1)** on average
Two keys on one slot: chain them, or take the next free slot
Grow the table once it is about three quarters full
The worst case is **O(n)**, which a good hash makes rare

steps.say: Collisions are handled by chaining or probing.
The table grows before it gets crowded.
And the worst case almost never happens.

scenes.narration: Dijkstra's algorithm comes down to one rule.
